rows.text: The judgment records that 'The accused, Noble Lasike, told me that he is the Speaker of the Legislative Assembly'.
rows.uncertainty: The accused's own evidence as reported in a judgment delivered on 9 July 2012; the day he gave evidence is not printed, so no structured date is stored.

rows.text: The Supreme Court (Chief Justice) found that the accused, Noble Lasike, was in possession of two live .22 bullets without a licence, contrary to section 4(2)(b) of the Arms and Ammunition Act, and convicted him as charged; the judgment is dated 'NUKU'ALOFA: 9 July 2012'.
rows.uncertainty: Context for the revocation of 17 July 2012; a conviction is not itself the end of the Speakership. The Court of Appeal later set the conviction aside (Lasike v R, AC 11 of 2012, 12 October 2012; a lead listed in the report, which never mentions the Speakership); no reinstatement is implied.

bounded_scope: Speaker observations for CLAUDE-C01-24 only (role to_speaker on the to_legislative_assembly observation). Royal appointment, the Assembly's election or recommendation of its Speaker, the oath, a resignation, a revocation, an acting or interim Speaker and a Deputy Speaker presiding stay separate rows; holder observations are decided in the packet, not by any row.
